purpose: G1 fidelity gate for CGT tile-response compressibility

value_gate.note: held-out odd pixels, (E,T) vs black/white/colored bg

jacobian_gate.note: well-posed scale-aware absolute; raw jac_rel is degenerate for near-flat tiles (teacher_jac_norm~1e-4 -> ratios to 1e27)

q_weighted: work-weighted cumulative passing fraction, work=tile_work (Gaussian intersections per tile)

amdahl.model: fwd_ratio=[sum_pass R_best*gamma + sum_fail M]/sum_all M; S=1/fwd_ratio; M=tile_work

sampling: stratified random by tile work decile (non top-N), 6 views x 250 tiles x 3 ranks = 4500 records/combo
